The event is set for tomorrow from 6:30 to 9:30 PM, with cocktails and networking starting promptly at 6:30. Attendance tracking is enhanced with requests for unclaimed name tags, ensuring a balanced guest mix. The menu prioritizes dietary needs, featuring curated wines and a casual dining experience during the cocktail hour.

## Summary
The team reviewed a candidate-engagement use case involving product recommendations, catalog search and ranking, treatment-option ordering, and personalized flows; whether it qualifies as a pricing experiment remained unresolved. Preparation for the November 5 executive dinner at Foreign Cinema covered the 6:30 start, early arrival, materials, two-table seating for 16 and 10 people, menu expectations, and dietary restrictions including Graham’s tree-nut restriction. Attendance tracking still requires confirmation for approximately 20 registrants and five GrowthBook guests. The group discussed prospects and customers, including Salesforce as a new-logo opportunity and Klaviyo, Quizlet, Change.org, and Genius Sports as potential expansion opportunities. Dossier profiles, intent signals, ICP indicators, account-owner input, and competitor-tool references will support preparation, although detected technology usage is unconfirmed. Additional goals include strategic seating, advancing active opportunities, identifying podcast guests, reconciling attendance, and improving the dossier.

# KBYG - London Dinner
Date: 2026-11-12 | Duration: 25.030000686645508m

## Summary
The team confirmed a London dinner at The Main Mayfair, beginning at 6:30, with capacity for 20 guests. The table is set for 18, while 16 attendees and five GrowthBook attendees are registered; registration is paused pending seating review. Standby, wait-list, and overflow options remain available, with seating adjusted onsite according to arrivals and no-shows. The team prepared attendee dossiers using Rio, HubSpot, LinkedIn, and registration data, with discussion focused on ClickHouse, Lendable, Bright Horizons, EDF Energy, and a potential Expedia Group attendee linked to an active deal. Setup begins around 6:00, cocktails and networking at 6:30, and James or Graham will give a brief welcome. Name tags, venue cards, seating information, travel coordination, and restaurant communication were assigned. Menu accommodations include vegetarian, turkey, rib eye, gluten-free, dairy-free, and seafood preferences, with Caesar salad anchovies requiring attention. Expenses must be submitted through Brex under “London Exec Dinner 2026,” while attendance will be confirmed through arrival tracking and name-tag collection.
